entries.title: Job 22:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: 1 Eliphaz shews that man's goodness profits not God. 5 He accuses Job of divers sins. 21 He exhorts him to repentance, with promises of mercy.

entries.title: Job 22:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a man. 35:6-8; Ps 16:2; Lu 17:10 as he that, etc. or, if he may be profitable, doth his goodsuccess depend thereon? 21:15; De 10:13; Pr 3:13-18; 4:7-9; 9:12; Ec 7:11,12; Mt 5:29 Ga 6:7,8

entries.title: Job 22:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: For thou. 24:3,9; Ex 22:26; De 24:10-18; Eze 18:7,12,16; Am 2:8 stripped, etc. Heb. stripped the clothes of the naked. 24:10; 31:19,20

entries.title: Job 22:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: But as. 29:7-17; 31:34; 1Ki 21:11-15; Ps 12:8; Mic 7:3 mighty man. Heb. man of arm. honourable. Heb. eminent, or,accepted for countenance. 13:8

entries.title: Job 22:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: not God. Ps 115:3,16; Ec 5:2; Isa 57:15; 66:1 height. Heb. head. the stars. Ps 8:3,4

entries.title: Job 22:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: cut down. 15:32; Ps 55:23; 102:24; Ec 7:17 whose foundation was overflown with a flood. Heb. a floodwas poured upon their foundation. Ge 7:11,17-24; Mt 24:37-39; 1Pe 3:19,20; 2Pe 2:5

entries.title: Job 22:17
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Depart. 21:10,14,15; Isa 30:11; Mt 8:29,34; Ro 1:28 and what. Ps 4:6; Mal 3:14 for them. or, to them.

entries.title: Job 22:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: our substance. or, our estate. 4:7; 8:3,4; 15:5,6; 20:18,19; 21:27,28; Lu 13:1-5 the remnant. or, their excellency. the fire. 1:16; 20:26; Ge 19:24; Lu 17:29,30; 2Pe 2:6,7

entries.title: Job 22:21
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Acquaint. 1Ch 28:9; Joh 17:3; 2Co 4:6 him. that is, God. be at peace. Isa 27:5; 57:19-21; Mt 5:25; Ac 10:36; 2Co 5:20; Php 4:7 Eph 2:14-17

entries.title: Job 22:24
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: lay up. 1Ki 10:21; 2Ch 1:5; 9:10,27 as dust. or, on the dust. Ophir. Ge 10:29; 1Ki 9:28; 22:48; Ps 45:9; Isa 13:12

entries.title: Job 22:25
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the Almighty. Ge 15:1; Ps 18:2; 84:11; Isa 41:10; Ro 8:31 defence. or, gold. Ps 16:5,6; Isa 33:6; 2Co 6:10; Jas 2:5 plenty of silver. Heb. silver of strength.

entries.title: Job 22:29
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: men. 5:19-27; Ps 9:2,3; 91:14-16; 92:9-11 he shall. Pr 29:23; Isa 57:15; Lu 14:11; 18:9-14; Jas 4:6; 1Pe 5:5 the humble person. Heb. him that hath low eyes. Ps 138:6; Isa 66:2; Eze 21:26,27; Lu 1:52

entries.title: Job 22:30
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: He shall deliver the island of the innocent. or, Theinnocent shall deliver the island. 42:8; Ge 18:26-32; Isa 58:12; Jer 5:1; Ac 27:24 pureness. Isa 1:15; Mal 1:9; Mt 17:19,20; Ac 19:15,16; 1Ti 2:8; Jas 5:15,16
